change_size: three runner expressions plus one local wire; no child or core edit
safety_argument: MAC result handling occurs only in ST_MAC_WAIT.
ST_MAC_WAIT and ST_IDLE are distinct known encodings.
The runner therefore forces child table-valid low throughout every known-state result-handshake row.
The removed child table-valid factor is consequently one in those rows.
The remaining queue, loaded and fault factors are reproduced locally, and child fault is exactly fatal OR table_fault.
Result valid remains a separate accept qualifier; reservation and state gating are unchanged.
required_post_rtl_checks: focused assertion that old observable child input accept equals new local accept for known controls
parent table-valid held high during MAC_WAIT while the accepted result still transfers exactly once
focused X/Z diagnostic showing and documenting any four-state difference without coercion
same four DW/PW vectors, all 640 intermediate and writeback values, exact 5433 no-stall cycles
reset, terminal fault, queue full, long backpressure and random commit-ready cases
risks: A missing state or reservation term could acknowledge a MAC result outside the existing transaction boundary.
Using parent table-valid directly would be wrong; only child table-valid is proven zero in MAC_WAIT.
Replacing child fault with a partial fault expression could accept after fatal or table load failure.
Two-state enumeration alone does not establish identical X/Z propagation.
Cycle or count changes would show unintended scheduling behavior and must fail the candidate.
decision: Do not implement until the 16,384-row known-state proof passes with zero mismatches.
